Exercise 2. a) I drink tea every day. b) Tomorrow we'll go to medina. c) I want to see the medina. d) He works in the police department. e) I don't understand. f) I have to go now. 3. a) I... b) us · c) you (m.) or she · d) They e) I want to go. f) us ('we want to go') Exercise 4. a) our home · b) your book (of you) · c) the car of Karīm · d) my mother · e) my sister · f) your friend (of him) Exercise 5. a) I don't know.š) · b) Not now.māši) · c) There is no water.makaynš: but...š) · d) Is this food not good?māši) · e) He didn't come yesterday.š) · f) -Nothing. - (walu) 6. a) Allah ibarək fik · šukran · b) labas, l-ḥamdu li-llāh · c) Allah yʿṭik ṣ-ṣəḥḥa · d) Allah ibarək fik · e) bslama · Allah yḥfḍək · f) w-nta mən ahl l-ḫir

Exercise 8. a) «Mərḥba bik f-l-məġrib. She's the mother of Karīm. Tea. That in Morocco tea is not just a drink: it is welcome. Why does Luke speak in fuṣḥā "Like television" means: Karīm He decides to teach him Darija during the summer. b) How long have you been studying Arabic and working in the police as Karīm. Don't be afraid: he will slowly understand, because they speak quickly. Bnin bəzzaf!!!!!!! «b-ṣ-ṣəḥḥa w-r-raḥa• Luke responds to • God yʿṭik ṣ-ṣəḥḥa». c) Breakfast early, then Karīm He'll take him to the old town. Not to go alone in the alleys, because even the inhabitants of Fès are lost. At 1:00, they come home for the couscous. Lalla Zhor's aunt with her kids. In the afternoon everyone will go to Bab Boujloud to drink tea, if Luke is not tired. Future: ⁧غادي نفطرو⁩ · ⁧غادي يديك⁩ · ⁧غادي ترجعو⁩ · ⁧غادي تجي⁩ ; Denials: ⁧ما تمشيش⁩ · ⁧ما عييتيش.⁩ Unit verification. 1. What do you want? 2. Where is it? Karīm?» · 3. Let's go now. 4. I don't understand darija well. 5. Is this book yours? 6. There's no bread. 7. I have to work tomorrow. 8. No problem. 9. Allah ibarək fik (o šukran). · 10. Allah yʿṭik ṣ-ṣəḥḥa. · 11. "I' (I'm going to go) in Egyptian and in fuṣḥā n- indicates · 12. In front of names, adjectives, parties and adverbs: māši mezyan, māši Daba. · 13. With dyal: l-ktab dyali. · 14. Two between: short vowels reduced or dropped; ǧ → ž; ṯ → t; ḏ → d; q → ʾ in the traditional Fès speech, g in the countryside. C · Text for the tutor (to read twice, at the natural rhythm; voice message of Karīm):
⁧أ لوكا، فين نتا؟ أنا قدام باب بوجلود، كنتسناك. إلا ما لقيتينيش، صيفط ليا ميساج. الواليدة قالت⁩
⁧ليك ما تعطلش، حيت العشا غادي يكون واجد مع التسعود.⁩

Questions: 1. Where is it? Karīm And what are you doing? (Before Bab Boujloud: wait Luke.) · 2. What does Luke have to do if he doesn't find him? (Send him a message: ṣifṭ liya mesaž.) · 3. What does the mother recommend, and why? (Don't be late, because dinner will be ready around nine o'clock.) Tutor notes: kantsənnak • • • • • • • • • • • • lqitinišš If you don't find me, please. ṣifṭ liya ... mesaž (from French) · but tʿəṭṭəlš Don't be late. mʿa t-tsʿud "to nine" is equal to nine.
